verse.text: A generous person will prosper; whoever refreshes others will be refreshed.

reflection.scripture: A generous person will prosper; whoever refreshes others will be refreshed.
reflection.observation: This proverb reveals a beautiful spiritual principle: generosity creates a cycle of blessing. The Hebrew word for 'refreshes' (yarah) carries the idea of watering or saturating—like rain nourishing dry ground. When we pour into others, we aren't depleting ourselves; we're participating in God's economy of abundance. True prosperity here isn't just financial—it's soul-deep flourishing that comes from living open-handedly.
reflection.application: Look for one person today who needs encouragement—a text, a call, a small act of kindness. Be intentional about refreshing someone who is spiritually or emotionally dry. Notice how giving refreshment often returns to you in unexpected ways.
reflection.prayer: Lord, make me a conduit of Your refreshment today. Show me who needs a word of hope, a moment of presence, or a simple act of love. Help me trust that in pouring out, You will fill me up. In Jesus' name, amen.
